I'll inspect the files in this directory and run the test to see what's failing.The parser ignores seconds. I'll add `s` support so cases like `1h2m3s` match the expected totals.`node test.js` passes.

The bug was that `parseDuration` only matched `h` and `m`. Some inputs include seconds (for example `1h2m3s`), so those cases were undercounted. I updated the regex to `/(\d+)([hms])/g` and added handling for `s`.
thought: `broken.js` parses durations for hours and minutes but omits seconds.
